channel.title: Zig Guide Live blog
channel.description: Posts about Zig, each written against a named compiler.

item.title: The File That Was Not There
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: A short story about a passphrase tool that worked on one laptop and failed on every other. The fix is @embedFile, and a word list the compiler checks line by line. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.

item.title: The 2 GB Log File at 11 PM
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: A short story about an on-call engineer, a 2 GB log file, a server where nothing can be installed, and a 274 KB Zig program. Every program in it runs in your browser. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.

item.title: builtin.mode is deprecated: read builtin.optimize
item.dc:creator: Rajesh Pillai
item.description: Zig master deprecated builtin.mode, builtin.cpu and builtin.os. Here is what replaces each one, and how to check your own compiler. Written against Zig 0.17.0-dev.2056+79a9897cd.
